findings.title: Detail-page 'VIEWING HELD' pill unpinned; the '>VIEWED<' absent pin never exercises the Viewed arm
findings.detail: Every detail-page test renders test_detail() whose fixture status is Submitted (client_test.gleam:2276), so the Viewed pill arm never renders; reverting line 566 to 'VIEWED' passes the whole suite. 4/5 #613 surfaces are pinned; this one is not.
findings.recommended_fix: Add one detail-page test with a Viewed-status application asserting 'VIEWING HELD' present and '>VIEWED<' absent (mirrors status_pill_viewed_renders_navy_test); in the same fixture assert the viewed stepper stop serializes without the title hint.

findings.title: Unbounded multi-toast stack (cap 5, no max-height) grows downward into the banner's button zone on small viewports where the banner fits
findings.detail: Container is fixed top-20 with no max-height; 5 toasts at ~72px + 12px gaps reach y~488. On 320x480/568 with the collapsed ~356px banner, 3-5 concurrent toasts (5-8s lifetimes, cap 5 verified at client.gleam:6459) cover the bottom-aligned buttons; toast z (2147483001) outranks the banner. Evidence artifact validated a single toast only, so the README's 'every case where the buttons actually ARE bottom-aligned' is overstated. Rare in practice; toast is dismissible and auto-dismisses.
findings.recommended_fix: Bound the stack (max-height + overflow, or clamp live toasts to 2-3) and/or soften the README guarantee to the single-toast case; re-run corner evidence with a full stack if left unbounded.

findings.title: Toast z-index hardcodes consent.js's banner value with a one-way, comment-only linkage
findings.detail: z-[2147483001] is derived from consent.js:393's 2147483000 (verified), an asset owned by another module; only the toast side is test-pinned. A future banner z raise silently re-hides toasts with no CI signal.
findings.recommended_fix: Extend the toast position test to read consent.js and assert the banner z-index stays below the toast pin, binding both values in one guard.

findings.title: Corner-case README prose names 'Reject all' among buttons the toast overlaps; its own geometry contradicts it
findings.detail: Geometry JSON: toast y 80-152; reject-all y 9-52 (no intersection); only Customize (60-103) and Accept all (111-154) intersect. The buttons are also vertically stacked, not a 'row'. Vision check of the corner screenshot confirms 'Reject all' fully visible. Documentation-accuracy only - the trade-off itself is user-flagged and not re-litigated.
findings.recommended_fix: Amend README line 71 to name only 'Customize' / 'Accept all' as overlapped.
